languages.title: Letterhead in Uzbek and English
languages.hint: A letter is printed on the letterhead of its text language. An empty field is printed in Russian. Uzbek is in Latin script.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.hint: Format and labels of all numbers: requests, projects, documents, orders and shipments.
numbering.prefixHint: Up to 16 characters: letters, digits, “-” and “_”.
numbering.prefixTaken: The prefix is taken by another company
numbering.ticketLabelInvalid: Request label: Latin letters and digits, up to 16 characters
numbering.labelsHint: A number is the same in every language: Latin letters A-Z and digits only.
numbering.labelInvalid: Latin letters A-Z and digits only
numbering.previewHint: The sample follows the draft scheme; counters do not change.
numbering.note: New numbers follow this scheme; issued ones do not change.

quote.marginHidden: Margin fields are hidden: roles with cost and margin rights see them.
quote.thresholdHint: Completeness from which a card may be published (1–100).
quote.note: New quotes take these values; issued quotes do not change.
quote.remindOverdueHint: Once a day at 10:00 Tashkent time — one reminder per invoice more than three days past due: in the customer portal bell and by email to the project contact and to contacts invited to the portal. Off by default.
quote.expiringDays: Warn before a partner price expires, days

sales.title: New quote terms
sales.hint: What a new quote gets: validity, payment, warranty, margin, delivery basis.
sales.note: New quotes take these values; issued quotes do not change.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.hint: Catalog price display and the card publishing threshold.
catalog.note: Applies to the catalog right away.

taxes.title: Quote currency and VAT
taxes.hint: What a new quote gets and how many days an exchange rate counts as fresh.
taxes.note: New quotes take these values; issued quotes do not change.

reminders.title: Invoice and act reminders
reminders.hint: Overdue invoices and acts: when and how often to remind.
reminders.note: Takes effect from the next reminder.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.hint: How a contract is assembled and sent after the quote is accepted.
contracts.note: Rules apply to new contracts; assembled ones do not change.

supplier.title: Supplier price freshness
supplier.hint: How many days a partner price counts as confirmed and how many days ahead to warn about expiry.

quote.contract_auto_send: A contract from an approved template goes to the Cabinet by itself after the quote is accepted
quote.contract_auto_sendHint: No visas without deviations. Off — the contract is sent by hand.
quote.contract_sign_before_send: Our signature comes before sending to the client
quote.contract_sign_before_sendHint: Off — the contract goes out as soon as it is assembled.
quote.contract_deviations_allowed: Deviations from the template — by request to the Legal holder
quote.contract_deviations_allowedHint: A contract with a deviation follows the visa route and does not go to the client before it.
quote.requireMxikHint: A card without an MXIK (IKPU) code cannot be published. Published cards stay; the check applies on the next publish.
quote.requireHs: HS code is required for imported goods
quote.requireHsHint: Origin is not Uzbekistan or is not set — it cannot be published without an HS code.

charges.hint: Amounts and rates per delivery basis for costing: freight, insurance, customs.

empty.text: Add amounts and rates per delivery basis — they go into the request calculation.

journal.title: Rate journal
